Application Data.NAME: Java Beans Coffee Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Java Beans Coffee Co. operates as a cozy coffee shop and tea house where customers can enjoy a curated selection of high-quality coffee and tea beverages, along with light snacks. We emphasize ethical sourcing of our products, creating an inviting space for social gatherings or quiet relaxation. Our operations include on-site seating for patrons, barista-led workshops, seasonal drink specials, and community events aimed at fostering a love for coffee culture. We also offer retail products, including coffee beans and tea leaves, for customers to take home.
